page.overview:
What is Jade Pool?

The is a pavilion where the Queen Mother of the West holds banquets.

The Jade Pool is an extravagant jade tower surrounded by auspicious clouds. Above a screen printed with the images of nine phoenixes stand a rainbow stool, a golden table, and jade bowls holding flowers. During a banquet, all sorts of rare and delicious food is laid out.
